title: Sparse Attention for Video Generation Acceleration via Growing Sparsity and Reduced Search
title_zh: 通过稀疏度增长与搜索缩减实现视频生成加速的稀疏注意力机制

paragraphs.en: 通过分析注意力的动态变化，提出了一种新的稀疏注意力机制来加速视频生成过程。 Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) dominate video generation but suffer from high inference cost due to the quadratic complexity of self-attention. Sparse attention mitigates this by skipping unnecessary computation in the attention matrix, but existing methods apply a fixed sparsity ratio throughout denoising and struggle to accurately determine which computations to skip. To address these limitations, we analyze attention dynamics through attention entropy and mean attention distance, and find that attention becomes increasingly concentrated across denoising steps. We further observe that blocks selected early continue to capture a large fraction of the total attention weight at later steps. These findings suggest two acceleration opportunities: the sparsity ratio should grow as denoising progresses, and earlier search results can be reused to reduce the search space. Based on these findings, we propose Growing Sparsity and Reduced Search (GSRS), a training-free framework that retains more computation early and progressively reduces it later, while restricting subsequent searches to an early candidate set to reduce search overhead. GSRS adopts Top-p selection for adaptive sparsity control, supported by a precise evaluation scheme that computes exact attention weights within the FlashAttention computation at negligible overhead. Experiments on HunyuanVideo and Wan 2.1 validate that GSRS achieves 1.55$\times$--2.21$\times$ speedup while maintaining generation quality comparable to full attention.
paragraphs.zh: 通过分析注意力的动态变化，提出了一种新的稀疏注意力机制来加速视频生成过程。扩散Transformer（DiTs）在视频生成中占主导地位，但由于自注意力的二次方复杂度而面临高昂的推理成本。 稀疏注意力通过跳过注意力矩阵中不必要的计算来缓解这一问题，但现有方法在整个去噪过程中使用固定的稀疏比率，且难以准确判断应跳过哪些计算。 为了解决这些局限，我们通过注意力熵和平均注意力距离分析注意力动态，发现随着去噪步骤的推进，注意力变得越来越集中。 我们进一步观察到，早期选出的块在后续步骤中仍然占据总注意力权重的很大比例。 这些发现提示了两条加速途径：稀疏比率应随去噪进程逐步增大，并且可以复用较早的搜索结果以缩小搜索空间。 基于这些发现，我们提出了增长稀疏与缩减搜索（GSRS），这是一个免训练框架，在早期保留更多计算并在后期逐步减少计算，同时将后续搜索限制在早期候选集合内以降低搜索开销。 GSRS 采用 Top-p 选择来实现自适应稀疏控制，并由一种精确的评估方案支持，该方案在 FlashAttention 计算中以可忽略的开销计算精确的注意力权重。 在 HunyuanVideo 和 Wan 2.1 上的实验验证了 GSRS 实现了 1.55$\times$--2.21$\times$ 的加速，同时保持与全注意力相当的生成质量。
